reason: Jamku charges only ₹6,500 a year for practice management, so committing to Docketra at ₹12,990 for only 5 seats—or ₹60,000 for my entire team—feels far too steep. On top of that, being paranoid about client confidentiality, I cannot justify paying a massive premium when I have avoided third-party cloud databases for years to prevent data leaks.
objection: Jamku charges only ₹6,500 a year—why is Docketra more expensive?
would_change_my_mind: A competitive mid-sized firm plan under ₹15,000 a year for up to 15 seats, combined with an independent security audit certifying that client Drive files never leak.
